EnvId.description:
Identifies one materialisation of a unit. A unit re-materialised after reclaim
gets a new environment, not a new unit.

ResourceKey.description: What is being held, as `kind:value`, for example `port:5432` or `device:usb0`.

Timestamp.description: A UTC instant, serialised as an RFC 3339 string.

description:
A claim on a singular resource. It expires so that a crashed session cannot hold a
fixed port forever.

expires_at.description: When the claim lapses unless renewed.
